summary: ARM64 Docker images for Temporal Server and admin-tools were missing for versions 1.30+ on Docker Hub, though they were available in 1.29. The issue was fixed via PR #9631 and arm64 images are now available.
userImpact: Users on ARM64 architecture (Apple Silicon, AWS Graviton) cannot run Temporal Server versions 1.30+ without available arm64 Docker images.
rootCause: Docker build or CI/CD process failed to generate and push arm64 images for versions 1.30+
resolutionDetails: Fixed via PR #9631; arm64 Docker images are now available for Temporal Server and admin-tools 1.30+
keyQuote: Starting from 1.30 version there no arm64 images on dockerhub
